item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `ImageModel` with required `image: dspy.Image`, optional `image_list: list[dspy.Image] | None`, and uses it as `model_input` in a `dspy.Signature`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Builds `model_input` with one direct image and one list image, attaches it as a demo to a predictor, then dump/load round-trips state before the checked call."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Configures `DummyLM` with `{'output': 'Multiple photos'}`, calls the reloaded predictor, and asserts `out.output == 'Multiple photos'`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Inspects LM `messages`, counts `image_url` blocks, and asserts the post-round-trip call contains exactly 4 image blocks."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `'<DSPY_IMAGE_START>' not in str(msgs)`, explicitly checking against placeholder-text flattening."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
